purpose: Results of a second 100-pass acquisition sweep restricted to sources not already represented by MM-DATA-001..178. Searches emphasized raw repositories, supplementary tables, industrial production studies, transfer datasets, multicavity measurements, material-lot effects and longitudinal/near-raw records. No third-party raw payload is committed and canonical counts remain unchanged until admission gates pass.

searchAudit.interpretation: Six genuinely distinct sources survived duplicate and evidence-quality review. Several are measured and unusually useful, but rights and raw-admission status remain source-specific.

sources.name: iGuzzini five-day industrial road-lens injection-moulding quality CSV
processFields: screw position at end of hold
sources.qualitySemantics: Four quality classes derived from photometric road-lens general uniformity U0: waste, acceptable, target and inefficient.
sources.dataQualityGate: README reports 1451 rows, but its displayed class counts 370+406+310+360 total 1446. Exact row-level class counts must be recomputed from the pinned CSV before any profile is accepted.

rights.releaseStatement: README states dataset and experiment source code are freely released for research and educational purposes.
rights.requiredAction: Clarify permission for commercial/internal product use before copying or redistributing raw rows.

sources.value: High-value real industrial labelled process dataset with five separated production days, enabling day-held-out temporal/domain validation instead of random-row-only evaluation.
sources.nextAction: Profile the exact pinned CSV outside the product repository: exact rows, class counts, duplicates, missingness, ranges, day identity if recoverable, unit validation and leakage-safe day-based splits; resolve reuse rights before canonical admission.

sources.name: Recycled-polypropylene machine-learning process-control raw appendix
sources.value: Adds directly tabulated recycled-PP material-variation and control-response evidence linking incoming material rheology to process state and physical/mechanical outcomes.
sources.nextAction: Transcribe or retrieve the literal appendix table with provenance, verify units and distinguish measured rows from model/control outputs; request author data if a fuller chronological table exists.

sources.name: Medical-device scientific-moulding transfer, material-lot and cavity-balance dataset
sources.value: Rare source combining machine transfer, material-lot variation, multicavity physical measurements and post-transfer process validation in a medical-device moulding context.
sources.nextAction: Extract publisher-verifiable measured tables with shot/cavity identity intact; contact authors for original cycle-level transfer/DOE data and reuse terms.

sources.name: Foxconn industrial injection-moulding dimensional and high-frequency sensor corpus mirror

mirrorFiles.path: List of fields and their meanings.docx

reportedSignals: high-frequency sensor data from 24 sensors with stage-dependent 20/50 Hz acquisition
sources.value: Potentially exceptional industrial multimodal corpus, but provenance/permission risk is high enough that the mirror must be treated only as an acquisition lead until original-owner rights are established.
sources.nextAction: Trace the original Foxconn/competition terms or contact the data owner; only after explicit permission should exact files be downloaded, fingerprinted and profiled.

sources.name: 59-part injection-moulding transfer-learning repository
sources.provenanceBoundary: Published study states results are based on simulation data and require experimental validation; this source must never be counted as measured production evidence.
sources.value: Large cross-part geometry/process transfer family useful for model-architecture and transfer-learning stress tests while kept strictly separate from measured evidence.
sources.nextAction: Inspect GitLab file inventory and repository licence through a supported route; fingerprint exact simulation tables and preserve part identity for leave-part-family-out evaluation.

sources.name: Micro versus conventional injection-moulding multicavity precision/accuracy study
sources.value: Independent physical-quality comparison across conventional and micro-injection equipment with cavity identity retained; useful for scale/process transfer validation.
sources.nextAction: Retain measured tables as article evidence and seek author-level cavity/part source measurements if reusable raw files exist.

duplicateExclusions: scatimdata/AVAPS high-resolution pressure-flow datasets: already present in the staged admission queue
FORinFPRO-HIMD: already present in the staged admission queue
Mendeley data model gtnb4j7bfx: already represented as MM-DATA-011
University of Leon 2026 PP process/defect datasets: already MM-DATA-023/MM-DATA-024
pyscrew moulding-variation scenarios: already represented in prior candidates
truthBoundary: 184 is a research-discovery count only. Measured/public/article/simulation/mirror status must remain distinct, and none of these six increases canonical measured-family or accepted-value counts before source-specific admission.
